title: Verdict Record (one element of the POST /api/reflex/verdicts body)
description:
Versioned contract for the rival verifier's verdict AS IT CROSSES THE WIRE — the VerdictRecord type in api/src/types.ts, posted by bin/sensei_writeback.py and consumed by ReflexEngine.setVerdicts. Draft-07 is mandatory, not stylistic: ajv 6.15.0 (api/package.json) rejects 2020-12 outright while Python jsonschema 4.26 accepts it, so a 2020-12 schema passes the Python tests and silently fails on the TS side.

NAMED FOR THE TYPE IT VALIDATES, not for the ledger's `rival_verdict` field — they are different objects and conflating them is the mistake this naming avoids. This carries cycle_id and ts (wire routing) and omits confidence and mode (the rival agent's own envelope); the ledger row carries rival_verdict as a bare string alongside pillar and action_taken. See sensei_ledger_row.schema.json.

ENFORCEMENT IS SPLIT, deliberately. server.ts keeps its hand-rolled 400 gate on the structural fields (reflex_id, verdict, cycle_id, ts, reflex_ready) — that is a network boundary and downgrading it to warn-only to satisfy A2's 'reject nothing' would be a regression. This schema adds WARN-ONLY observability on top, so the fields the 400 gate never checked (reasoning, evidence) are measured before A3 decides what to enforce. The two agree by construction: everything required here that the gate also checks is rejected there first.

reflex_id.description: Reflex the verdict is about. Also checked by the 400 gate.

verdict.description: SUSPECT never reaches this endpoint in practice — SKILL.md Step 6 posts only CONFIRMED and REFUTED — but the type permits it, so the vocabulary matches VALID_VERDICTS rather than narrowing behind the gate's back.

reasoning.description: NOT checked by the 400 gate. A verdict with no reasoning suppresses a reflex for 24h with nothing a human can review — the exact failure this warn-only window exists to measure.

evidence.description: NOT checked by the 400 gate. On a CONFIRMED verdict the rival's own contract requires this to state the refutation attempt that failed, not merely what was checked.

cycle_id.description: Groups the verdict with its cycle's ledger rows. Also checked by the 400 gate.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC. sensei_writeback stamps this at POST time. Also checked by the 400 gate.

command.description: Optional mitigation command echoed back from the reflex.

reflex_ready.description: Governance opt-in grant — set true on a CONFIRMED verdict for a mechanism-backed metric. Optional so pre-grant and legacy posters are unchanged; the 400 gate already rejects a non-boolean when present.
